author: Derek Denny
title: Panthers Drop Pitcher's Duel to BBE, Losing 1-0 - NewsBreak
text:
By Derek Denny ,
1 days ago Parkers Prairie experienced another pitcher's duel in an elimination game vs Belgrade-Brooten-Elrosa on Tuesday which saw the same result as their game on Monday with Brandon-Evansville, as the Panthers came up short, losing 1-0. Only two hits were managed by us with Isaac Ruckheim getting one in the first, and Gavin Boesl with a hit in the bottom of the seventh to give us life, but in the end, we weren't able to tally any more or coax any walks.
